mascot.name: Vy, the Vysify mascot

tips: Photos with a clean background and good light make much better creatives.

roles.owner: I own a store or brand

dashboard.title: Your dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Create ads from your product photos.
dashboard.emptyFirstText: Start by adding a product with a good photo. Then pick a goal and I'll take care of the rest.
dashboard.emptyText: You already have products. How about generating your first campaign?

products.title: Products
products.subtitle: The products you want to advertise. Each one can have several campaigns.
products.emptyText: To create ads, the AI needs to know your product. Upload a sharp, well-lit photo.

new.title: Add product
new.subtitle: The more context you give, the better the ads.
new.photoTip: Tip: simple background, whole product in frame and good lighting. Only upload images of products you have the right to use.
new.name: Product name *
new.descriptionPlaceholder: What it is, who it's for, differentiators, materials...
new.audiencePlaceholder: E.g.: people who work out and work away from home

detail.deleteConfirm: Delete this product and all of its campaigns? This can't be undone.
detail.emptyText: Generate the first campaign for this product in a few clicks.

dropzone.label: Drag the photo here or click to choose
dropzone.hint: PNG, JPG or WEBP · up to {mb} MB
dropzone.invalidType: Use a PNG, JPG or WEBP image.
dropzone.tooLarge: The image can be at most {mb} MB.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.subtitle: Everything you've generated, newest first.
campaigns.emptyText: Pick a product, set the goal and I'll generate strategy, copy and creatives for you.

wizard.title: New campaign
wizard.subtitle: Four steps and the AI builds everything for you.
wizard.noProducts: You don't have any products yet.
wizard.objectiveSub: This guides the strategy and the tone of the copy.
wizard.audiencePlaceholder: Leave blank to let the AI define it from the product
wizard.offerPlaceholder: E.g.: 20% off your first order and free shipping
wizard.languageHint: On automatic, the AI uses the language you ask for (e.g. "in Spanish") or the one you wrote in. Copy and voiceover come out in that language.
wizard.refundNote: If any variation fails, its credits are refunded automatically.
wizard.verifyFirst: Confirm your email (link in the notice at the top) to generate campaigns.
wizard.notEnough: Not enough credits. <buy>Buy credits</buy> or reduce the variations.
wizard.briefing: What do you want in the ad? (optional)
wizard.briefingPlaceholder: E.g. video showing the bottle at the gym, upbeat tone, highlight that it keeps drinks cold for 24h. Want another language? Just ask: "dubbed in Spanish".
wizard.briefingHint: Write it your way. The AI uses the language you write in (or the one you ask for) for the copy and the voiceover.
wizard.durationHint: Videos longer than 5 s are made of 5-second scenes that continue exactly from the previous scene's last frame, with the voiceover already inside.
wizard.vyFooter: Vysify only creates ads for products and services. Adjust your request and try again — no credits were charged.
wizard.applyLogoHint: Places your Brand Kit logo in the bottom-right corner of every image or video.
wizard.noLogo: Upload a logo in the <link>Brand Kit</link> to apply it to your creatives.
wizard.referencesHint: Attach up to 3 images, like a model, a setting or a style, and mention them by number in your request. E.g. “use the bottle from image 1 and the model from image 2 talking about it”.
wizard.imageRights: I'm authorized to use the image of the people shown in these photos (or they're me).
wizard.vyImageFooter: Underwear and swimwear are welcome as products: on a hanger, a mannequin or worn by adults in catalog poses. Nudity, sensual content, violence, minors in that context and celebrities aren't allowed.

generating.title: Generating your campaign
generating.videoNote: Videos can take a few minutes. You can close this page: generation continues and you'll get an email when it's done.

gallery.deleteConfirm: Delete this campaign and all of its creatives? This can't be undone.
gallery.failedNotice: {count, plural, one {1 variation couldn't be generated} other {# variations couldn't be generated}}. The corresponding credits are already back in your balance.
gallery.regenDescription: Generates one more creative in this campaign for {count} credits. If it fails, the credits are refunded automatically.
gallery.instructionsPlaceholder: E.g.: light marble background, golden-hour light, close-up of the product
gallery.regenStarted: New variation is being generated. It will show up here shortly.

publish.title: Publish creative
publish.description: Publishes now, to the chosen account, as an organic post.
publish.unavailable: Direct publishing is coming soon. For now, use “Download” and “Copy text”.
publish.connectPrompt: Connect your Facebook/Instagram account to publish from here.
publish.noAccounts: No compatible account. For Instagram, the account must be a professional account linked to a Page. Check <link>Integrations</link>.
publish.storyNoCaption: Stories have no caption. If you want text, it needs to be in the image itself.
publish.caption: Caption
publish.responsibility: Review prices, features and claims before publishing: you are responsible for the content you post.
publish.sentVideo: Sent! Instagram takes a few minutes to process videos.

billing.title: Buy credits
billing.subtitle: You have {count} credits. One-off packs — no subscription, no auto-renewal. Credits never expire.
billing.noPlans: No packs available in this currency right now.
billing.secureBR: Payments processed by Mercado Pago (Pix, card and boleto) or Stripe. We never store card details.
billing.secureIntl: Payments processed by Stripe, with a receipt and invoice by email. We never store card details.
billing.refund: Unused credits can be refunded within {days} days of purchase.

toast.success: Payment received! Your credits will show up in a moment.
toast.pending: Payment pending. Credits are added automatically once it's confirmed.
toast.canceled: Payment canceled. You were not charged.

credits.title: Credits
credits.subtitle: Your balance and every transaction.
credits.pricingNote: Strategy and copy are included. Failures are refunded automatically.

brand.title: Brand Kit
brand.subtitle: Your brand identity. Fill it in once and the AI applies it to every campaign.
brand.logoHint: Shown in the bottom-right corner of images and videos when you tick “Apply my logo” while creating a campaign. A PNG with a transparent background works best.
brand.name: Brand name
brand.tonePlaceholder: E.g.: Young and direct, with a sense of humor. We avoid jargon and never use offensive slang.
brand.nameHint: The AI mentions the brand in the copy and once in the video voiceover.
brand.colorHint: Used subtly in the scene of images and videos (background, props, lighting). The product itself is never recolored.
brand.toneHint: Guides how headlines, copy and the voiceover script are written.
brand.websiteHint: Added at the end of the caption as an invitation (e.g. “Shop at termix.com”). It isn't spoken in the voiceover.
